required_training: RT-130, Wildland Fire Safety Training Annual Refresher (WFSTAR)
S-490, Advanced Wildland Fire Behavior Calculations
S-491, Intermediate National Fire Danger Rating System
required_experience: Satisfactory performance as a Division/Group Supervisor ( DIVS )
